learning_outcomes.text: Organize and carry out activities related to the maintenance of renewable energy source systems.
Decide practical issues related to renewable energy source systems maintenance.

syllabus_topics: The organization of the renewable energy parks electrical power equipment maintenance.
The Solar power equipment and parks maintenance.
The biogas and geothermal systems maintenance.
The maintenance of the electric apparatus for the protection and control processes of the electric power equipment.
The electric power machines and transformers maintenance.
assessment_rules: The exam includes a written part on two topics from the study material. This is followed by oral discussion and forming of the final mark.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Electrical Power Engineering (Bachelor)
